import sys

def compress_sentence(n, words):
    result = words[0]
    for i in range(1, n):
        word = words[i]
        overlap = 0
        for j in range(1, len(word) + 1):
            if result[-j:] == word[:j]:
                overlap = j
        result += word[overlap:]
    return result

input = sys.stdin.read().split()
n = int(input[0])
words = input[1:]
print(compress_sentence(n, words))
